top_strength: Nicole expertly gathered all four discovery basics upfront, asked the customer's agenda before probing, then went two layers deep on concerns (timeline, storage unit fullness, access, location details) and reflected back what she heard to confirm accuracy.
coaching_note: Section 4 never asks 'Does that feel fair?' and Section 6 never asks the catch-all 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' — both are critical silence checks that keep momentum and flag hidden objections late.
